Messages.Author: Michael J?rgensen
Messages.Body:
Hi!

This is the sitiaution.

You have Blanche Hill who is has changed clan to Malkavian. You have
an madness network in play.

After your preys minion phase Blanche Hill then takes an action with
Spirit Marionette to take one of your preys minions(who is not
malkavian). What happens now ? The minion cannot act because it is not
malkavian, does this mean you have it until your minion phase(where it
will bleed or hunt) If so, what happens if i play an social ladder in
my masterphase on the stolen vampyre? Will the blood on the minion go
to one of my vampyres ?

Thanks in advance - and happy new year !

Michael

Spirit Marionette

Card Text:

(D) Bleed at +1 bleed.

(D) Bleed at +1 bleed, and tap a ready minion controlled by your
prey (even if the target of the bleed is changed).

+1 stealth action. (D) Take control of any ready untapped minion
until the end of the next action. That minion must bleed your prey
unless he or she must hunt.
